B adds useful printing detail on flexo, foil and vinyl, and its suggested logo set is good, but it never mentions a one-color version. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers give the correct contrast figure (about 2.4:1), say they are working from a description, and suggest a darker gold, a separate favicon mark and gold on dark backgrounds.
